name: Hermetic eval-registry run with a variance-band delta gate
description: Turn 'this feels better' into a measured pass-rate. The mechanism that makes the number mean something is not the runner, it is the two controls around it: the variance band, measured by re-running one pinned case N times, below which a delta is NOT a delta; and the degraded-config control, which must score LOWER or the eval is measuring nothing at all. Hermeticity - no wall clock, no entropy, no unrecorded network on the dispatch path - is the precondition that makes both controls readable.

eval_set.description: The pinned case registry. Pinned by content hash, not by directory name.

system_under_test.description: Identifier of the configuration being measured.

baseline_config.description: The configuration the delta is measured against.

variance_runs.description: How many times one pinned case is re-run to establish the band. Below 3 the band is not a band.

degraded_config.description: A DELIBERATELY worse configuration. If it does not score lower, the eval is not protecting anything.

min_eval_cases.description: Contraindication guard: below this the result is noise and the run reports NOT-CHECKED rather than a pass rate.

registry-pinner.description: Pins the eval set and both configs by content hash so the run is reproducible.

case-runner.description: Executes one eval case hermetically: no clock, no entropy, no unrecorded network on the dispatch path.

delta-adjudicator.description: Compares against the baseline and refuses to call a movement smaller than the variance band a delta.

owner.description: The human owner - decides which behaviours earn a standing eval case and who keeps them from ossifying.

stages.title: S0 - pin the eval set and both configs by content hash

work_unit.title: Pin the eval registry and the configurations under test
work_unit.question_or_target: Record the content hash of every eval case and of both configs, so a later run can prove it measured the same thing rather than a drifted set.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: deciding what constitutes the pinned surface is judgement; hashing it is not

work_unit.evidence_requirement: a sha256 per eval case and per config file, plus the case count, so a stale set is detectable rather than assumed fresh
tests_required: editing one eval case changes the pinned hash
a set below min_eval_cases is recorded as NOT-CHECKED-too-small rather than silently run
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the delta-adjudicator, who will not read a pass rate whose registry is unpinned
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7601 emitted only when every case and config carries a hash and the case count is recorded; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7601 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: a registry pin either hashes the declared surface or the surface is undeclared
work_unit.mechanism: content-hash pinning of the case set and the configs

stages.title: A set too small to be signal reports NOT-CHECKED, not a pass rate
S1 - run every case hermetically on the system under test

body.title: One case on the system under test

work_unit.title: Execute one pinned eval case against the system under test, hermetically
work_unit.question_or_target: Run one case with no wall-clock read, no unseeded entropy and no unrecorded network on the dispatch path, and record pass or fail with the case hash.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the case body is judgement work; the hermeticity constraint is mechanical and asserted

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the case hash, the pass/fail verdict, and a count of clock, entropy and network accesses observed during dispatch - all three must be zero
tests_required: a case that reads the wall clock on the dispatch path FAILS the hermeticity gate rather than being scored
re-running an identical case with an identical config yields an identical verdict
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7602 emitted only when a verdict exists for the case and the three hermeticity counters are all zero; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7602 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: retrying a nondeterministic case is how a flaky pass becomes a reported improvement
work_unit.mechanism: hermetic single-case execution with clock/entropy/network counters

stages.title: S1b - the same pinned cases on the baseline config

work_unit.title: Execute one pinned eval case against the baseline config, hermetically
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce the baseline arm of the comparison under identical hermeticity constraints, so the delta is a difference in the system and not in the harness.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the baseline arm must be run by the same role under the same constraints or the comparison is between two harnesses

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the case hash, the verdict, and the same three hermeticity counters at zero
tests_required: the baseline arm runs the SAME pinned case hashes as the under-test arm; a hash mismatch fails the comparison
both arms record the same hermeticity counters
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7603 emitted only when a baseline verdict exists per case with matching case hashes; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7603 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: retrying a nondeterministic case is how a flaky pass becomes a reported improvement
work_unit.mechanism: matched-hash baseline arm under identical hermeticity constraints
work_unit.not_a_duplicate_because: the same executor with a different config is what makes a delta attributable; a single arm can only report a level, never a change

stages.title: Both arms must be complete before any comparison
No clock, no entropy, no unrecorded network - or the run is not hermetic
S3 - establish the re-run variance band on ONE pinned case

body.title: Re-run the same pinned case with the same config

work_unit.title: Re-run one pinned case repeatedly to measure the harness's own variance
work_unit.question_or_target: Run the identical case against the identical config variance_runs times and record the spread, because a delta smaller than this spread is not a delta.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the same executor must produce the variance estimate or the band belongs to a different harness

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every individual re-run verdict, the observed spread, and the resulting band expressed in the same unit as the pass rate
tests_required: an identical config re-run produces a pass rate stable within the declared band
both-states control: injecting one deliberately nondeterministic case WIDENS the band, proving the measurement is sensitive to real variance
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the delta-adjudicator, who uses the band as the threshold and must not be the one who chose it
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7604 emitted only when variance_runs results are recorded and a band is computed from them, not asserted; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7604 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: re-running for a better variance band would measure the retry, not the harness
work_unit.mechanism: repeated identical-config re-runs producing an empirical variance band

stages.title: A deliberately degraded config MUST score lower, or the eval measures nothing

work_unit.title: Run the pinned set against a deliberately degraded config
work_unit.question_or_target: Prove the eval can SEE a regression by running a config known to be worse and requiring a lower score; a suite that stays green on a degraded config is not protecting the behaviour.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the control arm shares the executor with the measured arms so a difference is attributable to the config

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the degraded config's pass rate, the under-test pass rate, and the margin between them measured against the variance band
tests_required: the degraded config scores LOWER than the system under test by more than the variance band
if it does not, the run reports the eval set as NOT PROTECTING the behaviour rather than reporting an improvement
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the delta-adjudicator, who must treat a surviving degraded config as a finding about the EVAL, not about the system
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7605 emitted only when the degraded arm completed and its margin against the under-test arm is compared to the band; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7605 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: a degraded control that scores high is a finding about the eval, not a flaky run
work_unit.mechanism: deliberate-regression control arm gated on the measured variance band
work_unit.not_a_duplicate_because: the variance loop measures the harness's noise; this measures the eval's SENSITIVITY, and a suite can be quiet and still be blind

stages.title: S2 - compare, and refuse to call a sub-band movement a delta

work_unit.title: Adjudicate the delta against the baseline using the measured variance band
work_unit.question_or_target: Report pass_rate, delta_vs_baseline and a verdict of IMPROVED, UNCHANGED-WITHIN-BAND or REGRESSED, where UNCHANGED-WITHIN-BAND is the required verdict for any movement smaller than the band.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the judge authority is where the anti-overclaim rule is enforced, so it is not delegated to the runner

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per-case verdicts from both arms, the band, and the arithmetic showing whether the delta clears it
tests_required: a delta of +1.2 points against a band of +/-2.0 points is reported UNCHANGED-WITHIN-BAND, never as an improvement
a run whose degraded control did not score lower reports the eval as non-protective and withholds any improvement claim
both-states control: a delta of +8 points against the same band IS reported IMPROVED, so the gate is not simply refusing every claim
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who recomputes the delta and the band from the two result files
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7606 emitted only when a verdict token is recorded together with the band and the degraded-control outcome; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7606 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: a delta adjudication is a judgement over recorded arms and cannot be retried into truth
work_unit.mechanism: variance-band-thresholded delta adjudication with a mandatory UNCHANGED-WITHIN-BAND verdict

stages.title: An improvement claim needs a supra-band delta AND a working degraded control
Owner decision - which behaviours earn a standing eval case, and who keeps them fresh
stages.prompt: This run measured N cases with a band of B. Which of these behaviours deserve a STANDING eval case, and who owns them so the set does not ossify into something the system is merely overfitted to?

impact.blast_radius: writes only under command-center/eval/hermetic-registry/**; the pinned registry itself is forbidden to writes

worked_example.scenario: A hook change is claimed to improve goal re-injection. The eval set is 40 pinned session cases; the baseline is the pre-change harness; the degraded config disables the injection entirely.
expected_trace: measure-variance -> 5 re-runs of one case give a band of +/-2.5 points
degraded-control -> 19/40 pass, 35 points below under-test: the eval CAN see a regression
compare-to-baseline -> delta = +5.0 points against a band of 2.5 -> IMPROVED
delta-gate -> PASS. Had the delta been +1.5, the verdict would be UNCHANGED-WITHIN-BAND and no improvement could be claimed

bp7.unverified: UNVERIFIED case coverage - the registry merged here has the framework and the bench has the probes, but neither ships a case set for this estate's behaviours. Settling experiment = the degraded-config control itself: if the eval cannot see a deliberate regression it is not protecting anything, and this workflow makes that arm mandatory rather than optional.

distinct_from.BP-MNT-02: that one revalidates that things FIRE; this measures whether behaviour is BETTER on a fixed case set
distinct_from.bp-dat-03: that one asks whether the measuring device is sound; this assumes a sound device and asks whether the SYSTEM moved
distinct_from.bp-dat-04: no tiers, no spend ceiling, no survivors - the case set is fixed in advance and every case is run
